title: People
summary: Find colleagues in the new people directory and organisation chart, and keep your own profile up to date.

added: Your own profile, which you can edit. HR-only details stay hidden from everyone else.
A people directory with search and filters.
An organisation chart, built from who reports to whom.
Student placements: log your hours and have them signed off by your supervisor.
A Security page that links to your Cloudron account settings.
changed: Your intranet account is created or updated when you sign in, and closed when you leave APES.

internal_notes: A read-only directory sync runs on a schedule and ends the sessions of deactivated members.
Admins can see who has two-factor sign-in turned on.
